summary.text: Keith P. Brown won election to the New York State Assembly on November 3, 2020, and represents parts of Suffolk County, including Huntington, Babylon and Islip.
His official biography describes him as an attorney and former Assistant Attorney General who lives in Northport.

paragraphs.text: Brown graduated from SUNY Albany, where he interned for former state Senator Norman J. Levy, and attended Touro College Law Center, according to his Assembly biography.
He served as an Assistant Attorney General in the state Attorney General's Litigation Bureau, then became a litigator and established his own law firm.
He is a partner in the real estate and land use and zoning practice groups of Certilman Balin LLP.

The biography says his legislative focus includes small business, lowering taxes, the Long Island Sound, and state investment in water and sewer infrastructure, and that he voted to restore judicial discretion and repeal bail reform measures.
He lives in Northport with his wife, Barbara, and their three children.
